transform.orientation: decoded top-left arrays; Vector remains Blender bottom-up screen convention

formula.cameraConvention: Blender camera looks along local -Z; camera coordinates are transpose(R_camera_XYZ) * (world-cameraLocation)
formula.implementationIndependence: analyzer must implement scalar pinhole, Euler XYZ matrix, ray-plane, rigid inverse and projection math without bpy, bpy_extras, mathutils or tested reconstructor imports
formula.pixelCenter: decoded top-left integer pixel (x,y) denotes center ((x+0.5)/W, 1-(y+0.5)/H)
formula.predictedPreviousDepth: negative previous-camera Z of the transformed current local surface point
formula.surfacePoint: cast current pixel-center ray, intersect current local-z-zero plane, invert current rigid transform to local point, apply previous rigid transform
